verdict.rationale: Appwrite is explicitly designed to self-host via Docker on any machine (docs-14/19/33), has a CLI for managing projects, functions, and resources (docs-12/52), supports non-interactive CLI use for CI (docs-42), and Functions docs state 'Develop locally, deploy when ready' with 13+ runtimes (docs-48). Community corroboration notes the containerized setup makes local dev/testing easier (appwrite-comm-5). However there's no dedicated 'emulator' product (like Firebase's) — the local workflow is achieved via full Docker self-hosting rather than a lightweight emulator, and no evidence of a fast local-only dev mode distinct from full deployment. Missing for 10: dedicated lightweight emulator/local-dev mode, independent hands-on account of full local stack workflow before cloud deploy.
